web.voice_install_required: the offline voice engine is not installed yet; download it from the page first
web.voice_nothing_to_install: nothing to install: the offline voice engines are installed, configured otherwise, or not available on this platform
web.voice_not_installable: %s cannot be installed from the page
web.stt_format: %s cannot decode %s audio on this machine; reload the page (it converts recordings to WAV in the browser) or install ffmpeg (%s)
web.tts_empty: nothing to speak: the text is only code or formatting
web.ui.stt.denied: Microphone access was denied; allow it in the browser's site settings
web.ui.stt.unsupported: This browser cannot record audio here
web.ui.stt.hint: Voice input: click to talk, click again to stop, Esc discards
web.ui.voice.talkOn: Voice conversation on: speak, and the reply is read back
web.ui.voice.none: No voice engine is available in this process
web.ui.voice.install.title: Offline voice engine
web.ui.voice.install.body: Download the embedded voice engine (~{mb} MB, once) to talk offline? It runs on this machine, with no API key and no account.
cfg.web.voice_missing: %s, not installed (~%d MB; the page offers the download)
cfg.web.voice_unsupported: no prebuilt engine for this platform
cfg.web.voice_src_auto: fallback until the offline engine is installed
cfg.web.voice_about: The web page prefers the embedded speech engines (Whisper in, Kokoro out: offline, keyless) for every direction CHATCLI_TRANSCRIPTION_* and CHATCLI_TTS_* leave unconfigured, and asks before their one-time download. Set CHATCLI_TRANSCRIPTION_PROVIDER or CHATCLI_TTS_PROVIDER to pin another engine; the gateway and @speak keep their own defaults.
